# Catchly — Complete Specification & Architecture for LLMs

> Comprehensive documentation for language models, answer engines, and autonomous agents analyzing Catchly.

## Overview
- **Name**: Catchly
- **Product Type**: Browser Extension (Manifest V3)
- **Primary Function**: Personal subscription tracker, renewal reminder, and price-hike monitor
- **Platforms Supported**: Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Opera, and other Chromium browsers
- **License**: MIT (Open Source)
- **Website**: https://getcatchly.com
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Muzeeb1998/Catchly

## Privacy & Security Architecture
1. **Local-First Storage**: All subscription lists, spend analytics, renewal dates, and usage metadata reside in `chrome.storage.local`.
2. **No Bank Login**: Unlike competitors (Rocket Money, Copilot, Truebill) that require bank credentials via Plaid or MX, Catchly inspects local browser checkout pages on an explicit domain allowlist.
3. **No External Analytics**: No Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Segment, or Sentry SDKs are bundled.
4. **Isolated DOM**: In-page detection toasts render inside isolated Shadow DOM boundaries (`mode: "open"`) to prevent host page script collision or clickjacking.

## Feature Matrix
- Automated detection on 24+ services (Netflix, Spotify, ChatGPT, Disney+, Prime Video, Claude, Microsoft 365, Canva, Notion, GitHub, etc.)
- Multi-currency portfolio support with dedicated breakdowns
- Advance notification scheduling via Chrome Alarms API
- Monthly, yearly, weekly, and quarterly recurring rollover
- 4 built-in UI themes: System, Editorial, Utility, Dark
